message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The best numerical quality (85.14 dB, error 1.483) is achieved at coef_frac=15, but the symmetric_preadd structure at that precision already cuts area to 8520 um^2. Dropping to coef_frac=14 costs only ~6.5 dB SQNR (78.7 dB) while reducing area further, and there are 4 legal unvisited precision-decrease neighbors to explore, offering the best remaining trade-off between numerical quality and mapped area."}
